description: PAID: $0.05 when payment.amount_usd < 1 (POST /v1/verdicts), $0.50 when >= 1 (POST /v1/verdicts/large); the tool picks the route. FREE with PREDGE_KEY set to a pilot key (https://predge.io/start) inside its 30-day window. Send what was promised (job: endpoint, expected content type, JSON Schema, required fields, max latency, expected sha256), the delivery evidence (status, headers, body or body_sha256, timing) and the payment reference (amount_usd, tx_hash, network, payer, payee), optionally the buyer and provider agent identities (id, version, operator, authorization_ref). Returns an ed25519-signed verdict (delivered | not_delivered | inconclusive), per-check results, reason codes and a refund RECOMMENDATION (the merchant honours it; nothing is refunded automatically). Deterministic checks, no LLM. The tool re-checks the signature and returns `{ verification, record }`; re-read later for free with predge_get_verdict. Paying the $0.50 tier over x402 needs MAX_PRICE_USD >= 0.5. Without a key or buyer wallet the result is the API's 402 explanation (price and how to pay).
